title: Quick Puppet Pre-Rigged Arm IK
teaches: Pre-place shoulder, elbow, and wrist pins using Quick Puppet role ids.
Drag one wrist control while MotionLoom solves the elbow and keeps both authored bone lengths fixed.
Use explicit vertex bone bindings so the sleeve, forearm, hand, and elbow joint remain rigid.
Debug Puppet Warp interaction on one isolated arm before applying it to complex imported artwork.
